## Request Details

Requestor, date received, priority, source intent/anchor and approved owning folder.
Requestor is not automatically approver. Exact task/workflow context.

## Description

Requested change, present behavior and explicit affected scope; distinguish means
from stakeholder intent. Unrelated legacy text remains unchanged.

## Business Justification

Why needed; configuration/alternative means considered; effects of not changing;
compliance/standards evidence or justified N/A/unavailable. No invented benefit.

## Approval

One consolidated classification/conflict/approach/delta decision, not repeated
checkbox rituals. Actual approver/source/exact revision/sections/permitted writes,
residual risk and disposition; pending/rejected is not applied. Current bounded
approval reused. Large-scope or beyond-approved goal/acceptance/success/constraint
changes need actual human permission in all modes; guidance cannot replace it.
Material revisions need only their consequential decision before target edits.

## Execution

version rows/IDs, mockup links, affected evidence invalidation and unchanged bytes.
No feature creation/status allocation or implementation claimed here.
